summary: Rewrite the soydachi profile README.md in English: brand light/dark banner via <picture>, proper H1 + H2 hierarchy, live widgets replacing the dead stats card, canonical identity and contact, and all six research §06 defects closed.
plain_summary: Your GitHub profile page will look professional: a brand banner, clear sections, live activity badges, correct facts, and contact links that work.
gating: Work checkpoints in order. Within a checkpoint, the gates run in order: behavior, then ui, then review. A checkpoint is "passed" only when every gate is "passed" or "n/a". Do not start checkpoint N+1 until checkpoint N has passed.

checkpoints.title: Structure, banner, and identity
checkpoints.goal: Ship a valid English README that renders on its own: one H1, H2 sections without level skips, the existing banner pair embedded with <picture> and a descriptive alt, canonical identity (general engineer leads, Platform Governance Lead at Nationale-Nederlanden España backs), and a descriptive contact list. Closes §06 defects 1, 2, 3, and 5, plus the dead stats widget line, by rewriting the file.

plain.what: A clean page with a banner, clear sections, a short intro, and working contact links.
plain.why: Visitors see who you are and can reach you right away.
plain.check: Run the check script and see it finish without errors.

tasks: Rewrite README.md in English: H1 greeting (one H1, first heading), then the <picture> banner per research §09 snippet using .ai-engineering/images/profile-banner/image-01.jpg (light) and .ai-engineering/images/profile-banner-dark/image-01.jpg (dark), relative paths, descriptive English alt of at least 15 characters, width 1536, height 512.

Write ## What I do: first person singular, 'general engineer' identity leading, 'Platform Governance Lead at Nationale-Nederlanden España' as the backing fact, one concrete sourced statement (docs/brand/dachi-gogotchuri-profile.md §3, [DG] 2026-07-08).

Write ## Contact with descriptive text links only, no icon images: https://soydachi.com, https://www.linkedin.com/in/soydachi, mailto:info@arcasiles.com, https://instagram.com/vegasoulband, https://instagram.com/jaleo.band. Dropping the icon row removes §06 defects 1-3 (Instagram icon to twitter.com, alt typo 'LinkdeIn', simple-icons@v3 black in dark mode) and the old arcasiles.com contact link.

Remove the github-readme-stats image and the emoji bullet list. Voice per tono-y-estilo.md: first person singular, straight quotes, no em dashes as sentence joints, no emoji in the body, facts with a source.

Create .ai-engineering/scripts/check-readme.py: python3, no dependencies, prints every failed check and exits non-zero on any failure. It asserts: exactly one H1 and it is the first heading; at least two H2 headings; no heading level is skipped; no empty section (a heading immediately followed by another heading); the first block contains a dark source to images/profile-banner-dark/image-01.jpg, a light source to images/profile-banner/image-01.jpg, and an with alt >= 15 chars and width 1536; both image files exist on disk. Required substrings: 'Platform Governance Lead', 'Nationale-Nederlanden', 'general engineer' (case-insensitive), 'soydachi.com', 'linkedin.com/in/soydachi', 'mailto:info@arcasiles.com', 'instagram.com/vegasoulband', 'instagram.com/jaleo.band'. Banned substrings (defects and dead content): 'LinkdeIn', 'simple-icons@v3', 'github-readme-stats', 'https://arcasiles.com', 'https://www.arcasiles.com'. Forbidden data per canonical profile §16: 'NN Digital Hub', 'Cloud Solution', 'Platform Engineering Lead', 'Mobile Lead Engineer', 'Momentos que permanecen', '3000 members', '~3,000', '150 events', 'ai-mem', 'postflow', 'paperclip', 'arcasiles-hq', 'solution-intents', 'lifeos', 'arcasiles-lens', 'instagram.com/lasobremesa', 'boxing', 'MVP' unless the same line contains 'former', and the word 'we' outside other words (first person singular rule). Voice mechanics: no em dash U+2014, no curly quotes U+2018/U+2019/U+201C/U+201D, no emoji codepoints (U+1F000-U+1FAFF, U+2600-U+27BF, U+2B00-U+2BFF, U+FE0F), no 'TODO', 'TBD', or '[COMPLETAR]'.
acceptance: README.md is valid English Markdown: exactly one H1, at least two H2 sections, no skipped heading levels, no empty sections.
Banner renders light/dark from the existing pair via <picture> with a descriptive alt; both image files exist at the referenced paths.
Identity reads 'general engineer' first and 'Platform Governance Lead at Nationale-Nederlanden España' as the current role.
Contact contains soydachi.com, linkedin.com/in/soydachi, mailto:info@arcasiles.com, instagram.com/vegasoulband and instagram.com/jaleo.band as descriptive links; no icon images remain.
§06 defects closed: no simple-icons@v3, no 'LinkdeIn', no Instagram/twitter mismatch, no github-readme-stats, headings exist (pinned-repos defect is profile config, out of scope).
check-readme.py exits 0 on the final file; no forbidden §16 data, no em dashes, no curly quotes, no emoji.

findings: round 1: 8 findings (checker vs contract), round 2: F5 upheld (entry-scoped links), round 3: PASS; all resolved
